import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
meta = json.loads((root / 'artifacts/room-churn-client.json').read_text())
server = root / meta['runtime_path']
client = root / meta['directory'] / 'inspection'
output = root / 'docs/benchmarks/2026-10-16-room-churn-baseline.json'
record = {'scope': 'Eight exploratory ordinary baseline processes, separate from profiling. Four-second complete verified fanout with64/512 stable readers, windows1/16, stable membership or one temporary reader every2 windows. One native worker on CPUs0-3 and four client threads on CPUs4-7. No private traffic, inspection or separate-room churn. Full bodies, sender, order, transient welcome/window/Close/EOF and every departure; exact independent service counters and zero final resources. These are workload observations, not a before/after gain.',
          'source': meta, 'driver_source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'cases': [], 'passed': False}
for readers in [64, 512]:
    for window in [1, 16]:
        for every in [0, 2]:
            trace = output.with_name(f'{output.stem}-{readers}-{window}-{every}.json')
            command = [sys.executable, str(root / 'scripts/inspection.py'), '--server', str(server), '--client', str(client),
                       '--rooms', '0', '--pairs', '0', '--mode', 'none', '--inspectors', '0', '--churn-workers', '0',
                       '--fanout-readers', str(readers), '--fanout-window', str(window), '--fanout-churn-every', str(every),
                       '--seconds', '4', '--workers', '1', '--output', str(trace)]
            done = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=90)
            data = json.loads(trace.read_text()); assert done.returncode == 0 and data['passed'], done.stdout + done.stderr
            m = data['mixed']
            row = {'readers': readers, 'window': window, 'every': every, 'passed': True,
                   'trace': str(trace.relative_to(root)), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(trace.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                   'fanout': m['fanout'], 'membership': m['fanout_membership'],
                   'cpu_wall': m['server_cpu_seconds_per_wall_second'], 'client_cpu_wall': m['client_cpu_seconds_per_wall_second']}
            record['cases'].append(row); output.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n'); print(json.dumps(row), flush=True)
record['passed'] = True
output.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
